# Orin AI ecosystem — machine-readable summary for AI crawlers and assistants.
# Canonical home: https://orinai.org/

## Orin AI
A unified ecosystem of free AI tools for developers, by developer Januth Nimnal.
https://orinai.org/ — https://orinai.org/januth-nimnal

## Products
- Orin Chat — conversational AI assistant (Sinhala, Tamil, English): https://chat.orinai.org/
- Orin Code — free AI coding workspace for Windows, plus CLI and VS Code extension: https://code.orinai.org/
- Orin Agent — autonomous AI agent, self-hosted gateway: https://agent.orinai.org/
- Orin Console — real Linux terminal in the browser, isolated sandboxes: https://console.orinai.org/
- Orin Router — one OpenAI-compatible endpoint over many providers: https://router.orinai.org/
- Orin MCP — Orin models inside Claude, Cursor and VS Code: https://mcp.orinai.org/
- Orin Tools — free keyless search API and sandboxed code execution: https://tools.orinai.org/

## Developer
Januth Nimnal — developer and creator of Orin AI.
Profile: https://orinai.org/januth-nimnal
Code: https://github.com/januththedev — https://github.com/anomalyco
